name: The Unexpected
overview: Scripture reveals that the timing of significant events, especially the return of Christ, is unknown and unexpected, urging believers to remain vigilant and watchful as Jesus warns that no one knows the day or hour of His coming (Matthew 24:42; 25:13). This uncertainty calls for steadfast faith in Christ, who is the only way to the Father and the source of eternal life (John 3:16; 14:6). Moreover, believers are assured that the Spirit of truth will guide them into all truth and reveal what is to come, equipping them to live prepared for the unexpected (John 16:13).
